unresolved.detail: OpenMetadata's CLL chain (sqlglot → sqlfluff → sqlparse) returns 0 column edges on the verbatim user-reported SQL. The CREATE PROCEDURE ... AS BEGIN ... END wrapper defeats the parser chain before it reaches the inner DML, even though INSERT INTO #tempTable / INSERT INTO schName.targetTable would parse fine standalone. This is the exact symptom reporters describe in OpenMetadata#25299.
